tara: Heads-up from bringing up horizon-36k-int4v2. Running longprefill soak (25k tokens) and noticed repeated phrases from ~8k tokens earlier that only show up after GC/epoch roll events. Minimal logs and repro below. Anyone familiar with epoch-based kv GC interacting badly with RoPE snapshotted scaling?

owen: paste repro and compile/runtime flags?

tara: repro command:
```bash
./serve --model horizon-36k-int4v2 --prompt tests/long/25k.txt \ 
  --quant=int4v2 --kv-mode=epoched --kv-gc-threshold=10000 --rope_policy=epoch_adaptive
```
logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-05-18T14:02:03Z] prefill: wrote shard=2 epoch=7 seq_base=8200 len=1536 fp=0x9fa3c1b2 rope_scale=1.0012
[2026-05-18T14:02:04Z] kv: gc: advancing epoch 7->8 reclaim=12MB
[2026-05-18T14:02:04Z] prefill: write complete shard=2 next_seq=9736
[2026-05-18T14:02:05Z] decode: reading shard=2 epoch=8 seq=8200 fp=0x9fa3c1b1 rope_scale=0.9988
[2026-05-18T14:02:05Z] token_dup: token[20512]==token[1212]
```

miguel: fp LSB changed and rope_scale differs across epoch boundary. Two possible paths: epoch GC rebase moved origin and didn't normalize seq_base, or we recompute rope_scale per-epoch rather than snapshotting it with the shard header.

owen: Did you try disabling epoch GC or forcing rope snapshot? Which path is currently authoritative at replay?

tara: quick checks: turning kv-gc-threshold=infinite (no GC) eliminates the repro. Forcing rope_policy=fixed also eliminates the repro. Behavior is quant-sensitive: int4v2 triggers easily, q4_0 triggers less, int8 no repro.

miguel: likely root cause: we were storing only epoch id in the shard header and deriving rope_scale from global epoch->scale mapping at read time. If epoch mapping mutates during GC advance, read-time scale will differ from write-time. Combined with an epoch rebase that shifts seq origin you get fingerprint mismatch.

owen: mitigation steps: 1) Snapshot rope_scale into shard header at write time and prefer header value on read; 2) Normalize seq_base during epoch rebase and never allow negative or non-monotonic seq_base; 3) Add a fast assertion in the replay path to bail when fp != expected and emit epoch_did_change event.

tara: I've filed internal ticket KV-EPOCH-ROPE-42812 with repro, traces, and small dump: https://redwood.internal/issue/KV-EPOCH-ROPE-42812

ci-bot: CI job queued: CI/longprefill#42812 (staging)  will post results. :gear:

miguel: I'll prototype a patch that serializes rope_scale into the shard header and pins it for replay. Also adding unit test: prefill->gc-advance->replay should assert fingerprint equality.

owen: Short-term: disable epoched GC on int4v2 onboard canaries and enable a longer retention window. Also add the regression matrix to CI: {int4v2,q4_0,int8} x {gc on/off} x {rope_policy fixed/adaptive}.

tara: did that and re-ran a 12h soak with epoch GC disabled: no duplicates observed so far. Leaving the canary running for 24h before marking unblock. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

owen: I'll own the quick assert PR and add the pinned-rope header change. Will coordinate with miguel on the unit tests.

miguel: :thumbsup:
